title: Clinical Negligence Paralegal
description:
Clinical Negligence Paralegal
Location: Birmingham/Hybrid

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Clinical Negligence Paralegal to join a supportive and growing legal team.

Responsibilities
- Manage a supervised caseload
- Assist senior solicitors with complex clinical negligence matters
- Liaise with clients and medical experts
- Undertake legal research
- Prepare documentation
- Support cases through pre- and post-issue procedures

Key Requirements
- Law-related degree, graduate qualification or relevant professional training
- Previous legal experience, ideally within clinical negligence
- Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
- Excellent written communication and client care skills
- High attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines
- A proactive approach and willingness to work under supervision

What's on Offer?
- Hybrid and flexible working
- 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays and Christmas closure
- Bonus scheme and pension
- Health benefits and life assurance
- Enhanced family-friendly benefits
- Ongoing training, development and career progression
- Supportive working environment and team culture

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their legal career while contributing to meaningful clinical negligence cases.

Click on the link to apply or contact James Durkan at G2 Legal for more information.

title: Temporary Legal Secretary
description:
Temporary Legal Secretary (2 Week Assignment)

Jewellery Quarter, Birmingham

13.45 - 14.00 Per Hour

Immediate Start Required

BCR/JN/32587

Bell Cornwall Recruitment are looking for an experienced Temporary Legal Secretary to support the 2 solicitors in a high street law firm based in the Jewellery Quarter.

Secretarial support will mainly be required across Family, Criminal and Personal Injury matters.

A Temporary Legal Secretary will be required (But not limited) to:
- Answering incoming calls and taking accurate messages.
- Speaking to clients
- Arranging appointments and meetings
- Typing letters, emails and documents dictated by a solicitor.
- Formatting and reviewing documents
- Opening, updating and organising client files.
- Scanning, photocopying, saving and filing documents

A Temporary Legal Secretary will need experience in:
- Past experience supporting a Solicitor directly is essential
- Experience typing up documents, letters and emails
- Strong MS Office skills
- Comfortable answering phone calls and speaking with clients
- Knowledge of Case Management Systems

If you are Immediately Available, can commute to the Jewellery Quarter, and are experienced with supporting solicitors in day to day activities, don't hesitate to get in touch to find out more!
